boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain St Catherine University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Saint Paul food stops with currently posted late service or restaurant hours.

cards.title: Pizza Hut on Snelling
cards.subtitle: 610 Snelling Ave S, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the official ordering page to confirm whether carryout or delivery fits your evening; posted hours extend to midnight daily and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Snelling Avenue pizza option with carryout and delivery listed.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists this 610 Snelling Ave S location's restaurant hours through midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut — 610 Snelling Ave S
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours: midnight Sunday–Thursday; 1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: Jimmy John's on Grand
cards.subtitle: 975 Grand Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Check the online menu or place a pickup/delivery order before heading out; the location posts both restaurant and delivery hours until midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A Grand Avenue sandwich location with posted midnight service.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists restaurant and delivery hours of 10 a.m.–midnight daily for its 975 Grand Ave location.
cards.source_title: Jimmy John's — 975 Grand Ave
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and delivery hours are posted as 10 a.m.–midnight daily.

cards.title: Wendy's at Midway
cards.subtitle: 1770 University Ave W, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the location page for its current menu and service details; both restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted through 2 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue fast-food stop with nightly 2 a.m. hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours of 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. daily at 1770 University Ave W.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 1770 University Ave W
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are posted as 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. daily.

cards.title: Wendy's at Unidale
cards.subtitle: 612 W University Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Treat this as an anytime food option and verify the menu before travel; the official location page posts 24-hour restaurant and drive-thru service.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Wendy's location on West University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists its 612 W University Ave restaurant and drive-thru as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Wendy's — 612 W University Ave
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are posted as open 24 hours daily.

cards.title: Wendy's on Maryland
cards.subtitle: 255 E Maryland Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Check the official location listing before leaving; it identifies this Maryland Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours, including a drive-thru option.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Wendy's location in Saint Paul.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Saint Paul location directory identifies the 255 E Maryland Ave location as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Saint Paul locations
cards.access_notes: The official Saint Paul directory lists this location as open 24 hours; verify service mode before travel.

cards.title: Wendy's on Suburban
cards.subtitle: 1825 Suburban Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Confirm current options in the location directory before setting out; it lists this Suburban Avenue restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Wendy's stop on Suburban Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official Saint Paul location directory identifies the 1825 Suburban Ave location as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Saint Paul locations
cards.access_notes: The official Saint Paul directory lists this location as open 24 hours; verify service mode before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell on North Snelling
cards.subtitle: 565 N Snelling, Saint Paul
cards.notes: For a late drive-thru order, use Taco Bell's location page and allow for the indoor dining room to close earlier than the listed drive-thru schedule.
cards.short_summary: A North Snelling Taco Bell with drive-thru hours to 3 or 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours to 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 565 N Snelling.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 565 N Snelling
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 3 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Robert Street
cards.subtitle: 1630 Robert St S, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the location page when ordering late and plan for drive-thru service; posted drive-thru hours run to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Robert Street Taco Bell with late drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours to 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday at 1630 Robert St S.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1630 Robert St S
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Suburban
cards.subtitle: 1940 Suburban Ave, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the official location page for a drive-thru order after evening plans; it posts service until 1 a.m. most nights and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Suburban Avenue Taco Bell with posted late drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours to 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1940 Suburban Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1940 Suburban Ave
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours end earlier.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Rice Street
cards.subtitle: 1672 Rice St, Saint Paul
cards.notes: For the latest listed food stop here, use the drive-thru and check the location page first; its posted drive-thru schedule runs through 4 a.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A Rice Street Taco Bell with 4 a.m. drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–4 a.m. every day at 1672 Rice St.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1672 Rice St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted as open until 4 a.m. daily; dine-in hours end earlier.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named campus spaces for studying, meeting, recreation, reflection, and student-led arts, documented by St. Catherine University.

cards.title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.subtitle: Campus student center
cards.notes: Start at the Information Center for directions or checkout items, then use this central building to connect with campus services and other students.
cards.short_summary: The campus hub combines student services, dining, library access, and activity spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University identifies Coeur de Catherine as its campus student center and says it houses student services, dining, the library, and more.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Located on campus; individual services and spaces may have separate hours or access rules.

cards.title: The Pulse and Game Room
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Bring a class project to a booth, watch TV, or check out game supplies from the Information Center with a valid student ID.
cards.short_summary: A student-programming venue paired with a connected game room.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says The Pulse supports gathering, class projects, TV viewing, and student programming; its connected game room has supplies checked out through the Information Center.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Game-room supply checkout requires a valid student ID; food purchases at The Pulse are optional.

cards.title: Student Organization Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: For a club project, reserve this space for a meeting, workshop, or presentation and use its shared organization resources as applicable.
cards.short_summary: A working base for student clubs, leadership groups, and their meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University says the Student Organization Center is available to student clubs and organizations for meetings, workshops, presentations, and group business.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Intended for student clubs and organizations; coordinate use through the relevant campus process.

cards.title: Dew Drop Lounge
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Set up for a study session or a conversation with friends; coffee and grab-and-go items are available if you choose to buy something.
cards.short_summary: A lounge explicitly designated for studying and spending time with friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The university directs visitors to Dew Drop Lounge to study, spend time with friends, and access coffee and grab-and-go items.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine; refreshments are optional purchases.

cards.title: St. Catherine University Library
cards.subtitle: First floor, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Choose an independent or collaborative work session, use a computer, or ask a librarian for research help before settling into the collection.
cards.short_summary: A campus library built for study, collaboration, computers, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University says its library supports studying, independent and collaborative work, librarian consultations, and computer use.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: The library is on the first floor of Coeur de Catherine; check the library for current access and service hours.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room online or at the tablets outside each room when your group needs a dedicated place to read, plan, or work together.
cards.short_summary: Reservable library rooms for focused group work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library states that its group study rooms can be reserved online or on tablets outside each room.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Reservations are required or may be available; contact the Circulation Desk for booking assistance.

cards.title: Library Quiet Space
cards.subtitle: Lower level, St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Head to the lower level when you need individual quiet study; use the library’s other study rooms instead for conversation or group work.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet area for individual study within the library.
cards.evidence_claim: The library identifies a designated quiet space for individual study on its lower level.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s lower level; follow posted library policies.

cards.title: Dew Drop Pond
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University campus
cards.notes: Take a short outdoor reset by the pond, or use the nearby grounds as a meeting point before heading back to a campus activity.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus oasis with a bridge and chapel backdrop.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University describes Dew Drop Pond as an outdoor oasis on campus.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; use established paths and observe any posted campus notices.

cards.title: English Garden
cards.subtitle: Near Whitby
cards.notes: Use this named garden near Whitby for a quiet pause between classes, and leave the plantings and shared setting undisturbed for others.
cards.short_summary: A campus garden identified by St. Kate’s spiritual-life leadership as a peaceful setting.
cards.evidence_claim: A St. Catherine University news article identifies the English Garden near Whitby as one of a campus leader’s places to find a moment of peace.
cards.source_title: Welcoming a new academic year, and a new president | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden near Whitby; maintain quiet and respect landscaping.

cards.title: The Frey Theater
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University campus
cards.notes: Look for student-led productions during the academic year and attend when a public performance is scheduled; ticketing or event rules can vary.
cards.short_summary: A 180-seat black-box theater used for student-led productions.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University describes The Frey Theater as a 180-seat black-box theater that hosts two student-led productions each year.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Access depends on scheduled performances and event policies; tickets may be required for some events.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten nearby, under-21-friendly public places and activities with documented free admission or free use.

cards.title: See the animals at Como Park Zoo
cards.subtitle: Como Regional Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Enter during posted visitor hours and follow exhibit signage. Admission is free, with an optional donation; skip paid rentals and concessions for a no-cost visit.
cards.short_summary: A free animal-viewing outing in Como Regional Park.
cards.evidence_claim: Como Park Zoo states that admission is free and visitors are welcome whether or not they make the suggested voluntary donation.
cards.source_title: Visitor Map & Hours | Como Park Zoo & Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Open daily; the official visitor page lists seasonal hours. Optional donations and paid rentals are not required for entry.

cards.title: Walk the Conservatory gardens
cards.subtitle: Como Regional Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use the visitor map to choose a garden route and take time with the seasonal displays. Keep the outing free by declining the optional donation and rentals.
cards.short_summary: Indoor plant collections and seasonal displays with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Como Park Zoo and Marjorie McNeely Conservatory state that they are free and that everyone is welcome without making a donation.
cards.source_title: Policies & FAQ | Como Park Zoo & Conservatory
cards.access_notes: Official page lists seasonal daily visitor hours. The suggested donation is voluntary; photography rules apply.

cards.title: Browse Mia’s permanent collection
cards.subtitle: 2400 Third Avenue South, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Walk into the permanent-collection galleries without a ticket and pick one wing to explore together. Confirm an exhibition is not ticketed before adding it to your route.
cards.short_summary: A no-ticket museum outing centered on the permanent collection.
cards.evidence_claim: The Minneapolis Institute of Art says general admission to its permanent collection is always free and requires no ticket or reservation.
cards.source_title: Visit the Minneapolis Institute of Art—Always Free
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday–Sunday, with late hours on Thursday. Special exhibitions and some events can require tickets.

cards.title: Take a Capitol self-guided tour
cards.subtitle: 75 Rev. Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. Blvd., Saint Paul
cards.notes: Start at the information desk, then use the official itinerary to seek out the rotunda, chambers, and public art. A self-guided visit does not require a purchase.
cards.short_summary: A free public-building exploration of art, architecture, and government spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Minnesota Historical Society states that admission to the Minnesota State Capitol is free and that self-guided tours are available.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | Minnesota State Capitol
cards.access_notes: Official page lists public building hours and free guided-tour times. Guided-tour donations are suggested, not required.

cards.title: Stroll the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
cards.subtitle: 725 Vineland Place, Minneapolis
cards.notes: Take a self-guided loop through the outdoor works and gardens, then use the free digital guide if you want context for specific pieces. No ticket is needed.
cards.short_summary: An all-year outdoor art walk with free public access.
cards.evidence_claim: Walker Art Center says the Minneapolis Sculpture Garden requires no tickets and is always free to the public.
cards.source_title: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden | Walker Art Center
cards.access_notes: Open daily, year-round, 6 a.m.–midnight according to Walker Art Center.

cards.title: Swim or sit by Phalen Beach
cards.subtitle: 1400 Phalen Drive, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Bring what you need for a beach afternoon and use the guarded sand beach during its posted season. Watercraft rentals are optional and not part of this free plan.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal, guarded public beach with free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation identifies Phalen Park Beach as having free admission and free parking.
cards.source_title: Phalen Regional Park Beach | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal and weather-dependent; consult the city page for guarded beach hours. Rentals and some programs cost extra.

cards.title: Cool off at Parque Castillo’s splash pad
cards.subtitle: Parque Castillo, 149 Cesar Chavez St., Saint Paul
cards.notes: Visit during the seasonal splash-pad window and pair it with the playground or public art. Bring water and sun protection; no paid aquatic admission is required.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal splash-pad stop in Saint Paul’s West Side.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation says splash pads, including Parque Castillo, are available free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal; Parque Castillo’s facility page lists splash-pad hours as 9 a.m.–9 p.m. Confirm conditions before traveling.

cards.title: Make a summer stop at Conway Park Splash Pad
cards.subtitle: Conway Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Use this as a simple warm-weather meet-up and keep it purchase-free by using the city’s public splash pad. Check seasonal conditions before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed free splash-pad activity for summer.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation lists Conway Park among splash pads available to use free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal outdoor amenity; the city’s aquatics FAQ directs visitors to confirm location details and conditions.

cards.title: Use the Roy Wilkins Park splash pad
cards.subtitle: Roy Wilkins Park, Saint Paul
cards.notes: Plan a daytime summer meet-up around the splash pad and nearby park amenities. This activity needs no paid pool pass; verify seasonal operation before you leave.
cards.short_summary: A free seasonal splash-pad outing in a Saint Paul public park.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul Parks and Recreation lists Roy Wilkins Park among splash pads available to use free of charge during summer.
cards.source_title: Aquatics Frequently Asked Questions | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal outdoor amenity; check current city information before visiting.

cards.title: Settle into the St. Kate library
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine, first floor, St. Catherine University
cards.notes: Meet a classmate to study, work independently, use a computer, or ask a librarian for help. This is a St. Kate student resource; campus access and parking rules apply.
cards.short_summary: A campus study-and-connect space with documented free student services.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University states that library services are free and describes study space, print resources, computers, and group study rooms for students.
cards.source_title: University Resources for Parents and Families | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine’s first floor. The university notes that campus parking is permit-only on weekdays from 7 a.m.–5 p.m.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented campus settings for quiet work, collaborative sessions, computer-based tasks, and supported academic work.

cards.title: Library Lower-Level Quiet Study Space
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library, lower level
cards.notes: Bring headphones for any audio and use this designated quiet area for focused solo reading, writing, or problem sets.
cards.short_summary: A library lower level specifically designated for quiet individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s Library designates its lower level as a quiet study space and prohibits conversation, online meetings, and cell-phone use there.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Library quiet-study rules apply; headphones or earbuds are required for audio, and the library cannot guarantee silence.

cards.title: Study Room 125
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Reserve the room through LibCal, then use the stability-ball seating when a more active seated work setup helps.
cards.short_summary: A reservable library study room documented as having stability-ball seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library lists Study Room 125 as a location with stability balls for seating; student study rooms are reservable through LibCal.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Current St. Kate’s students reserve study rooms online or on the tablets outside rooms; reservations are within library open hours.

cards.title: Study Room 126
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library
cards.notes: Book a slot before meeting up, and use the stability-ball seating for a change from standard desk chairs.
cards.short_summary: A second reservable library room with documented stability-ball seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library identifies Study Room 126 as having stability balls for seating and provides online or in-library room reservation options.
cards.source_title: Accessibility | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Study rooms are for academic work and reserved for St. Kate’s students outside class time; book within library open hours.

cards.title: Library Main Floor
cards.subtitle: St. Catherine University Library, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Choose a table here for work that allows normal conversation, and keep calls or online meetings from disturbing nearby users.
cards.short_summary: The Library’s conversational-level study floor for independent or collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library permits normal conversational levels throughout its main floor and describes the library as a place to study and work independently or collaboratively.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Normal conversational levels are permitted; use headphones for audio and limit calls or online meetings with external speakers.

cards.title: Dew Drop Area
cards.subtitle: Library main floor, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Set up at the main-floor Dew Drop tables when you want a library-based work area with a documented assistive magnifier nearby.
cards.short_summary: A named Library main-floor area with tables and a documented TOPAZ magnifier.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library’s reservable-space policy identifies the Dew Drop area as a main-floor table area, and the accessibility page locates a TOPAZ Magnifier there.
cards.source_title: Library Reservable Space Policies | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to library rules; the area may have limited event availability so as not to disturb student use.

cards.title: The Pulse Booths
cards.subtitle: The Pulse, Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Bring a device and use the booth data ports for a class-project session in this student-programming and gathering space.
cards.short_summary: Booth seating in The Pulse with data ports for class-project work.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s states that students can work on class projects using the data ports in The Pulse booths.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: The Pulse is a shared venue for student programming and gatherings; plan for an active, social setting rather than a quiet room.

cards.title: Tutoring and Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine, Room 21
cards.notes: Book a tutoring appointment or arrange an onsite learning-strategy session when you want structured support alongside your coursework.
cards.short_summary: CDC 21 is the home of St. Kate’s Writing and Reading and Math and Science tutoring centers.
cards.evidence_claim: The Tutoring and Learning Center is in Coeur de Catherine Room 21, provides academic support across the university, and offers its services at no charge.
cards.source_title: Tutoring and Learning Center | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Book or cancel tutoring appointments through the university’s appointment link; onsite and online learning-specialist appointments are available Monday through Friday.

cards.title: Access and Success Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Library 66, lower level of the Library
cards.notes: If you are a student parent, ask Access and Success about the study rooms, computers, printer, and adjacent playroom in Library 66.
cards.short_summary: A Library 66 study setting equipped for student parents.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library use policy says Access and Success has student-parent rooms in Library 66 with computers, a printer, study spaces, and an adjacent playroom.
cards.source_title: Library Use Policy | St. Catherine University Library and Archives
cards.access_notes: This space is described for student parents; contact Access and Success for details before relying on it.

cards.title: St. Mary Hall Computer Labs
cards.subtitle: St. Mary Hall
cards.notes: Use the hall’s 24-hour computer labs for computer-based coursework, then follow residence-hall access expectations for the building.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall study resource with 24-hour computer labs.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Kate’s campus preview states that St. Mary Hall includes 24-hour computer labs and shared lounges.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: The university describes the computer labs as 24-hour; building access may be limited to residents or those with authorized campus access.

cards.title: Student Organization Center
cards.subtitle: Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Use the available computers for recognized club work, workshops, presentations, or other organization business with your student group.
cards.short_summary: A Coeur de Catherine work space equipped for student-club business and projects.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Organization Center is available to student clubs and organizations for business and work, with computers and space for meetings, workshops, and presentations.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine | St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Intended for student clubs and organizations conducting group-related business or programming.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten named destinations on nearby Saint Paul corridors, each with one documented reason to stop.

cards.title: Highland Park
cards.subtitle: Montreal Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Walk the Montreal Avenue edge and use the city park map to orient yourself before choosing from its trails, picnic areas, or other listed amenities.
cards.short_summary: A large city park with multiple documented outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Highland Park at 1200 Montreal Avenue and identifies picnic areas, cross-country ski trails, golf courses, disc golf, and an aquatic center among its amenities.
cards.source_title: Highland Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: City page lists park hours as sunrise to 11 p.m.; observe any posted closures or rules.

cards.title: Highland Park Disc Golf Course
cards.subtitle: Montreal Avenue and Edgcumbe Road corridor
cards.notes: Bring your own discs, start only within the marked course area, and use the city’s course map rather than playing on nearby roads, lots, or trails.
cards.short_summary: A city disc-golf course with a published rules-and-map resource.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul identifies the Highland Park Disc Golf Course at the Montreal Avenue and Edgcumbe Road corner and states that it is free to use from sunrise to sunset with users providing their own discs.
cards.source_title: Highland Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Free use is documented from sunrise to sunset; bring your own discs and follow the posted course rules.

cards.title: Old Highland Pool House
cards.subtitle: Montreal Avenue and Edgcumbe Road corridor
cards.notes: Pause at the Montreal–Edgcumbe corner to view the 1936 WPA-era pool house from public park space and pair it with the adjacent course map.
cards.short_summary: A documented historic pool house at a named park corner.
cards.evidence_claim: The City says the Old Highland Pool House was built in 1936 by the WPA and stands on the Highland Park Disc Golf Course at Montreal Avenue and Edgcumbe Road.
cards.source_title: Highland Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: View from public park areas and respect any temporary barriers or notices.

cards.title: Highland Park Aquatic Center
cards.subtitle: Edgcumbe Road corridor
cards.notes: Check the seasonal schedule before heading to Edgcumbe Road; the city lists open swim, lap swim, lessons, a splash pad, diving boards, and a water slide.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal outdoor city aquatic center with multiple swim options.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul lists the Highland Park Aquatic Center at 1840 Edgcumbe Road as a seasonal outdoor facility with open swim, lap swim, lessons, a splash pad, diving boards, and a two-story slide.
cards.source_title: Highland Park Aquatic Center | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Seasonal operation; the city lists paid admission for most swim options, with current schedules and closures posted online.

cards.title: Circus Juventas
cards.subtitle: Montreal Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Highland Park grounds as your reference point and look for the Bigtop, where the city places this nonprofit youth performing-arts circus school.
cards.short_summary: A nonprofit youth circus school located in Highland Park’s Bigtop.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul identifies Circus Juventas as a nonprofit performing-arts circus school for youth and states that it is located in the Highland Park Bigtop.
cards.source_title: Highland Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Programs and performances may require advance registration or tickets; check the organization’s current information before attending.

cards.title: Highland Park Community Center
cards.subtitle: Ford Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Stop at Ford Parkway to check the center’s current activity listings, then choose a documented option such as open gym, athletics, theatre, or a community event.
cards.short_summary: A city community center with programs, fields, and a theatre.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Highland Park Community Center at 1978 Ford Parkway and describes educational programs, open gym, athletics, theatre, family events, and outdoor fields.
cards.source_title: Highland Park Community Center | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Activities, memberships, rentals, and operating hours vary; consult the city’s current listings before visiting.

cards.title: Highland Park Library
cards.subtitle: Ford Parkway corridor
cards.notes: Use the Ford Parkway entrance for a library stop, then look for the documented study rooms, teen zone, public art, and additional internet stations.
cards.short_summary: A public-library destination integrated with the community center.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul identifies Highland Park Library at 1974 Ford Parkway and says its renovated shared facility includes study rooms, a dedicated teen zone, public art, and more internet stations.
cards.source_title: Highland Park Community Center | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours and service availability before traveling.

cards.title: Hidden Falls Regional Park
cards.subtitle: Mississippi River Boulevard corridor
cards.notes: Enter from Mississippi River Boulevard near Magoffin Avenue and follow the marked trail toward the falls; obey closures, especially after flooding or winter conditions.
cards.short_summary: A Mississippi River bluff park with a documented route to its waterfall.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Paul says Hidden Falls Regional Park is along the Mississippi River bluffs and gives access instructions from the Mississippi River Boulevard and Magoffin Avenue entrance to the falls.
cards.source_title: Hidden Falls Regional Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Roads, trails, and sections can close for flooding, construction, events, restoration, or other conditions; do not enter closed areas.

cards.title: Crosby Farm Regional Park
cards.subtitle: Crosby Farm Road corridor
cards.notes: Use Crosby Farm Road as the arrival point, then select a paved trail for a walk, run, or ride beside wooded areas, marshes, and the Mississippi River.
cards.short_summary: A riverfront regional park with approximately 6.7 miles of paved trails.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists Crosby Farm Regional Park at 2595 Crosby Farm Road and describes about 6.7 miles of paved trails along wooded areas, Crosby Lake marshes, and the Mississippi River.
cards.source_title: Crosby Farm Regional Park | Saint Paul Minnesota
cards.access_notes: Park areas may close because of high water, construction, wildlife management, restoration, or special projects.

cards.title: Kowalski's Grand Avenue Market
cards.subtitle: Grand Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use this Grand Avenue grocery stop for its documented café seating, then check the market’s current offerings if you want a deli, bakery, or prepared-food option.
cards.short_summary: A Grand Avenue market with café seating and prepared-food amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: Kowalski’s lists its Grand Avenue Market at 1261 Grand Avenue with café seating, deli and bakery ordering, a pasta bar, and a burrito bowl bar.
cards.source_title: Grand Avenue Market | Kowalski's Markets
cards.access_notes: This is a retail market; food and grocery purchases are optional and priced by the business.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented St. Kate traditions spanning service, worship, academic milestones, and alumni community.

cards.title: Citizen Katie Day of Service
cards.subtitle: Annual St. Kate service and reflection tradition
cards.notes: Register for the annual service day, join a project with campus and alumni volunteers, and stay for the reflection that connects the work to community.
cards.short_summary: A university-wide service tradition that began as a Residence Life activity.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine describes Citizen Katie as an annual university-wide tradition of service, community-building, and reflection, first begun as a Residence Life activity.
cards.source_title: Citizen Katie celebrates 20 years of service and community-building
cards.access_notes: Projects and registration vary by year; follow the University event information.

cards.title: Honor St. Kate’s Namesake
cards.subtitle: Annual Feast of Saint Catherine celebration
cards.notes: Attend the November community gathering to learn about the University’s namesake, then take part in the reception and welcoming prayer service.
cards.short_summary: An annual observance of the saint for whom the University is named.
cards.evidence_claim: The University calls the Feast of Saint Catherine an annual campus celebration honoring its namesake and patron saint.
cards.source_title: Campus prepares to celebrate Feast of Saint Catherine next week
cards.access_notes: Held annually around November 24; confirm the current event listing before attending.

cards.entity_name: Feast of Saint Catherine Candlelight Prayer Service
cards.title: Light the Chapel for the Feast
cards.subtitle: Our Lady of Victory Chapel • Feast of Saint Catherine
cards.notes: Join the evening service in Our Lady of Victory Chapel, where prayer and song culminate in candlelight for the feast-day observance.
cards.short_summary: The Feast service includes a candlelit chapel observance.
cards.evidence_claim: For the annual Feast of Saint Catherine, St. Catherine says the evening service includes prayer, song, and lighting the chapel with candles.
cards.source_title: Campus prepares to celebrate Feast of Saint Catherine next week
cards.access_notes: The service welcomes all faiths; confirm the annual schedule and accessibility details with University Events.

cards.title: Celebrate the Founders’ Feast
cards.subtitle: Spring observance of Saint Joseph and the CSJs
cards.notes: Attend the spring observance to connect the Sisters of St. Joseph founders’ legacy with service, social justice, reflection, and campus community.
cards.short_summary: A spring feast that links St. Kate’s founders with service and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine states that each spring it celebrates Saint Joseph and the work of its founders, the Sisters of St. Joseph of Carondelet.
cards.source_title: Feast of Saint Joseph
cards.access_notes: The 2026 event lists a chapel prayer service and Coeur de Catherine service projects; RSVP details are on the event page.

cards.title: Begin the Year Together
cards.subtitle: Annual opening of the St. Kate academic year
cards.notes: Watch for the late-August opening gathering, where students, faculty, and staff begin the academic year as one campus community.
cards.short_summary: The recurring campus gathering that opens the academic year.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine identifies its Opening Celebration as an annual event welcoming new and returning students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: St. Kate’s celebrates the “Power of We” at opening of 2025–26 academic year
cards.access_notes: Held at the start of the academic year; program details and participation may change annually.

cards.title: Process to Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: From Our Lady of Victory Chapel to The O’Shaughnessy
cards.notes: Follow the opening-day procession across campus after Mass, then gather in The O’Shaughnessy for the convocation and community welcome.
cards.short_summary: A chapel-to-auditorium procession embedded in St. Kate’s opening ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine reports that, by tradition, opening convocation follows Mass in Our Lady of Victory Chapel and a procession to The O’Shaughnessy.
cards.source_title: St. Kate’s celebrates the “Power of We” at opening of 2025–26 academic year
cards.access_notes: Part of the annual Opening Celebration; follow the current event schedule for route and attendance details.

cards.title: Mark Graduation with Baccalaureate Mass
cards.subtitle: Commencement weekend • Our Lady of Victory Chapel
cards.notes: If graduating or supporting a graduate, check the commencement schedule for this Catholic Mass that sends graduating students forth from the University.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Catholic Mass that opens the graduation-day observance.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine’s commencement page describes Baccalaureate Mass as a traditional Catholic Mass honoring and celebrating graduating students as they are sent forth.
cards.source_title: 2025–26 Commencement
cards.access_notes: Scheduled during commencement weekend; consult the current commencement page for date, time, and livestream information.

cards.title: Process into Commencement
cards.subtitle: Commencement weekend • Coeur de Catherine to The O’Shaughnessy
cards.notes: Graduates should use the current commencement instructions for check-in and lineup before joining the scheduled procession to The O’Shaughnessy.
cards.short_summary: Graduates process from campus lineup locations to the commencement ceremony.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine’s current commencement schedule includes graduate and faculty processions from Coeur de Catherine locations to The O’Shaughnessy.
cards.source_title: 2025–26 Commencement
cards.access_notes: For participating graduates and faculty; lineup instructions and ceremony groups are published annually.

cards.title: Honor an Inspiring Woman
cards.subtitle: Annual February Katie Fund tradition
cards.notes: Use the February giving event to recognize a woman who inspires you and, if you choose to donate, share her story through the campaign’s tribute format.
cards.short_summary: An annual St. Kate tradition recognizing women while supporting student scholarships.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine called Give to Honor Her its seventh annual tradition in 2025 and said it honors inspiring women while supporting the Katie Fund.
cards.source_title: Honor an inspiring woman on February 11
cards.access_notes: Participation includes an optional charitable gift; consult the annual campaign page for current details.

cards.title: Keep the Book Conversation Going
cards.subtitle: Annual alumni reading-discussion tradition
cards.notes: Join an announced discussion session to explore selected fiction and nonfiction, especially works that examine women’s lives and overlooked narratives.
cards.short_summary: A decades-old St. Kate alumni book-discussion tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine describes Conversation With Books as an annual St. Kate tradition that began six decades ago.
cards.source_title: Conversation With Books kicks off year of genre discussions
cards.access_notes: Discussion dates, books, and attendance arrangements are announced for each year’s series.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at St Catherine University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure first-weekend loop through campus resources, gathering places, and recurring arts or activity options.

cards.title: Start at the Information Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival · Coeur de Catherine, second floor
cards.notes: Pick up a campus map, confirm weekend locations, and ask about checkout items before setting out on your first campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for directions, campus information, and student checkout items.
cards.evidence_claim: The Information Center provides campus maps, directions, event locations, and checkout items; academic-year weekend hours are 9 a.m.–10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.access_notes: Located on Coeur de Catherine's second floor. The university lists academic-year Saturday and Sunday hours as 9 a.m.–10 p.m.; break hours vary.

cards.title: Take in Dew Drop Pond
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · campus outdoor stop
cards.notes: Walk over for a short reset outdoors, then use the pond as an easy landmark while you orient yourself around the campus hub.
cards.short_summary: A named campus pond suited to a brief outdoor pause between indoor stops.
cards.evidence_claim: St. Catherine University identifies Dew Drop Pond as an outdoor oasis on campus.
cards.source_title: Visit Campus
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus feature; check conditions and campus access before visiting.

cards.title: Meet up at City Sisters Coffee
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon · Coeur de Catherine, second floor
cards.notes: Choose a drink or snack if you want one, and use the pond-facing seating as a simple place to compare weekend plans.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee and grab-and-go stop overlooking Dew Drop Pond.
cards.evidence_claim: City Sisters Coffee is on Coeur de Catherine's second floor overlooking Dew Drop Pond and offers beverages, bakery items, and grab-and-go snacks.
cards.source_title: Dining
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Coeur de Catherine; consult dining services for current hours and menu.

cards.title: Find the library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Friday late afternoon · Coeur de Catherine
cards.notes: Locate a study spot, computers, and the service desk now so your first independent work session has an easy starting point.
cards.short_summary: A campus study and research destination with collaborative work and librarian support.
cards.evidence_claim: The library supports independent and collaborative study, librarian consultation, computers, and access to ACTC-library items for St. Kate's students and faculty.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.access_notes: Located in Coeur de Catherine. Check the library site for current service and building hours.

cards.title: Make dinner plans at The Pulse
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · Coeur de Catherine, first floor
cards.notes: Use the first-floor counter as a straightforward dinner option, then stay nearby if your group wants to keep talking after eating.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor campus dining option serving pizzas, hoagies, and other familiar fare.
cards.evidence_claim: Wildcat Kitchen at The Pulse is on Coeur de Catherine's first floor, accepts meal swipes for lunch and dinner, and serves personal pizzas, hoagies, and other items.
cards.source_title: Dining
cards.access_notes: Consult dining services for current hours, menu, and meal-swipe eligibility.

cards.title: Try a game-room hangout
cards.subtitle: Friday evening · connected to The Pulse
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and check out a game from the Information Center for an easy, alcohol-free group activity on campus.
cards.short_summary: A student gathering space with a connected game room and checkout-based supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pulse is a student-programming and gathering venue; its connected game room has games and activities, with supplies checked out from the Information Center using a valid student ID.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.access_notes: Game-room supplies require a valid student ID for checkout from the Information Center.

cards.title: Pause at Our Lady of Victory Chapel
cards.subtitle: Saturday morning · building #2 on the campus map
cards.notes: Step inside for quiet reflection and look for the stained-glass and tile details; visitors of all faiths are welcomed by the university.
cards.short_summary: A historic campus chapel for reflection, prayer, and Sunday Mass.
cards.evidence_claim: The university describes Our Lady of Victory Chapel as welcoming people of all faiths for sacred ritual, prayer, and reflection; Sunday Mass is at 10:30 a.m.
cards.source_title: Our Lady of Victory Chapel
cards.access_notes: The Chapel page lists Monday–Friday opening when the university is open and Sunday Mass at 10:30 a.m.; confirm current access before visiting.

cards.title: See what is showing at the Murphy Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · campus gallery
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition page before you go, then build a gallery visit around any listed artist talk or public program.
cards.short_summary: A named campus art gallery with changing exhibitions and associated programs.
cards.evidence_claim: The Catherine G. Murphy Gallery hosts exhibitions and listed exhibition events, including artist talks and performances.
cards.source_title: The Paglees: Between Reason and Madness
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions and event dates change; review the gallery's current exhibition page before visiting.

cards.title: Browse a route into campus life
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon · Coeur de Catherine 253
cards.notes: Stop by to learn where clubs work and meet, then choose one current organization or future activity fair to follow up with.
cards.short_summary: A campus base for student organizations, meetings, workshops, and leadership groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Organization Center is available to student clubs for meetings, workshops, presentations, and organizational work, and houses student-leadership offices.
cards.source_title: Coeur de Catherine
cards.access_notes: The university identifies the Student Organization Center as Coeur de Catherine 253; check with Student Center and Activities for access or meeting details.

cards.title: End with a calendar check at The O'Shaughnessy
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening · performance venue on campus
cards.notes: Look over the venue calendar and choose a future performance or campus event that fits your schedule, budget, and interests.
cards.short_summary: A campus performance venue with an event calendar spanning concerts, theater, dance, and lectures.
cards.evidence_claim: The O'Shaughnessy publishes an upcoming-events calendar for performances and community or university events at St. Catherine University.
cards.source_title: Events | The O'Shaughnessy at St. Catherine University
cards.access_notes: Event times, availability, and ticket prices vary; use the venue calendar and ticket information for the specific event.
